title: Universal Body Format (UBF)
description: Body schema for messages routed through Colony. Three central slots (system, messages, attachments) — at least one must be set. A pure file upload (attachments-only) is a legitimate message shape. Cell-specific top-level slots are allowed.

origin.description: Who a turn is from. `peer` (GH #847) is the other side's words: a turn that arrived from another colony or from another speaker in a room — never the agent's own person (`user`) and never its own answer (`assistant`).

happened_at.description: Optional EVENT time of this turn, as opposed to the instant a consumer received it. The one sanctioned slot for per-turn time (GH #135): a batch of turns replayed out of an import or an archive carries a different time per turn, so the time cannot live in the header, which is one per message. Consumers that stamp their own clock ignore it; a turn that omits it is unchanged, which is why the slot is additive.

speaker.description: Optional short name of who a `peer` turn is from (GH #847). Allowed only with `origin: "peer"`. Set on this side of a boundary, from a checked identity — the peer mount moves a value the other side sent into `hop.peer_speakers`.

speaker_ref.description: Optional participant reference of who a `peer` turn is from (GH #847): 8 or 12 lowercase hex digits, the same reference in every channel and in memory. Allowed only with `origin: "peer"`; the form leaves no room for a path, a bracket or a second name.
